Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building sizes, ages, classrooms, specialized spaces, and site plans (Section 4, Site Master Plans). Robust condition assessments cover major systems and connect condition data to instructional priorities and long-term capital planning (Cost Summaries and detailed scopes per site).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections over 10 years with methodology and demographic data. Capacity utilization is detailed by site and connected to specific facility actions including reconstruction, modernization, and flexible uses (Section 1.3 Master Plan Capacity, Section 2 Priorities & Financial Analysis).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications developed with stakeholders. The plan integrates district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning with comprehensive analysis of multiple programs including TK, special education, STEM, and flexible learning spaces (Section 3 Educational Specifications Program Vision Updated).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces with site-specific strategies for learning courts, playfields, shade structures, and rubber surfacing. Some districtwide data on outdoor learning environments and quads is provided, but greening and climate resilience framing is limited (Site Master Plans and Cost Summaries for outdoor learning environments and playfields).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate change impacts broadly but lacks detailed climate risk assessments or comprehensive resilience strategies. No evidence of climate readiness as a central theme or detailed mitigation strategies across the district.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Mentions energy efficiency projects such as HVAC upgrades and utility service improvements but lacks comprehensive data on energy use or detailed strategies for energy resilience, electrification, or decarbonization. No reference to state requirements like Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates for all projects, including escalation and contingencies. Uses a clear prioritization framework and outlines multiple funding sources and strategies. Considers long-term financial sustainability and aligns financial capacity with district priorities (Section 2 Priorities & Financial Analysis).
